basics.label: Optimization · Large-scale Learning · Representation Learning
basics.summary: Visiting research student at the Department of Mathematics, HKBU, and PhD candidate in Computer Science at Shenzhen University. publications.name: Joker: Joint Optimization Framework for Lightweight Kernel Machines
publications.description: A general nonlinear learning framework for large-scale data via joint optimization of lightweight kernel machines.
highlights: Processes 10M data points on a single consumer-grade GPU with 10 GB memory.

publications.name: NPSVC++: A Representation Learning Framework for Nonparallel Classifiers
publications.description: A Pareto-optimal representation learning framework for nonparallel classifiers.
highlights: Improves classification accuracy by 1.5% over conventional cross-entropy.

publications.name: Learning the Optimal Discriminant SVM with Feature Extraction
publications.description: An adaptive joint learning model of features and classification.
highlights: Complete convergence analysis and efficient engineering implementation.

publications.name: LighTwSVM: Efficient Linear Nonparallel Classifier for Millions of Data
publications.description: An efficient drop-in replacement for sklearn.svm.LinearSVC.
highlights: About 2× faster than LIBLINEAR with roughly 50% lower memory usage.

publications.name: Robust Twin Bounded Support Vector Classifier with Manifold Regularization
publications.description: A nonparallel classifier integrating a nonconvex robust metric and manifold structure to suppress noise.

publications.name: TaylorNet: Rethinking Monomial-based Graph Neural Networks with Taylor Expansion
publications.description: Contribution: generalization analysis — derived the generalization bound of GNNs formed by monomial graph filters with Taylor expansion, with asymptotic analysis.

publications.name: A Design Principle for Graph Neural Networks
publications.description: Contribution: generalization theory — Rademacher-complexity generalization bounds for graph-filter design of a family of GNNs in a continuous-graph view.

publications.name: Maximal Margin Support Vector Machine for Feature Representation and Classification
publications.description: Contribution: verified the optimization details — derivations and convergence of the joint feature-extraction and sparse-selection optimization.

publications.name: NSMNet: Stabilizing Linear State-space Memory for Breast Ultrasound Video Segmentation
publications.description: Contribution: idea formulation — identified the rank-vanishing issue of linear attention; designed a stabilizing state-space memory for breast ultrasound video segmentation.

publications.name: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Benchmark and Robust Text-Free Inference for Breast Ultrasound Video Segmentation
publications.description: Contribution: led problem formulation — annotation challenges for multi-modal breast ultrasound video segmentation; formulated a semi-supervised scheme via text-free inference.
